# Helllo.ai

> Helllo.ai builds AI products for customer experience and revenue growth. RevEngg is our autonomous revenue engineering platform for B2C e-commerce brands (the flagship product at helllo.ai). Spark is our AI website assistant for SMBs. Helllo Voice is our AI voice agent platform for enterprise customer experience.

## Products

- [RevEngg — Autonomous Revenue Engineering Platform](https://www.helllo.ai/): Continuously observes customer signals, builds customer intelligence, decides the next best action, and autonomously engages customers across Voice, WhatsApp, Email and Web to maximise revenue for B2C e-commerce brands.
- [Spark — AI Website Assistant](https://www.helllo.ai/spark): Paste your URL, get an AI assistant trained on your site in 30 seconds, embed with one script tag. Answers questions by chat or voice, navigates visitors to the right page mid-conversation, and books meetings on Google Calendar, Calendly, or Cal.com. Free forever plan available.
- [Helllo Voice — AI Voice Agents](https://www.helllo.ai/helllo): Production-ready AI voice agents with agentic orchestration for phone and customer experience automation. Enterprise-grade, CRM-integrated, multi-language.

---

## RevEngg — What It Is

RevEngg is an AI Revenue Engineering platform built for B2C e-commerce brands. It runs the full customer lifecycle — Acquire, Qualify, Convert, Retain, Grow — as one continuous, autonomous loop, rather than a set of disconnected marketing and support tools.

## RevEngg — How It Works

1. **Lead Discovery** — finds high-intent customers across every acquisition channel: Facebook Ads, Google Ads, website visitors, organic search, WhatsApp leads, and marketplaces.
2. **Creative Intelligence** — generates and tests ad creatives and campaign variations with AI, promoting winning variants automatically.
3. **Lead Enrichment** — automatically appends firmographic and behavioral intelligence (company, revenue, industry, buying intent, location, social) to every lead.
4. **Qualification** — scores every lead on context and buying intent, routing the hottest leads into a priority queue.
5. **Planning** — a contextual decision engine (observe → reason → recommend → execute) picks the next best action per customer, using memory of past orders, conversations and browsing.
6. **Conversation Agents** — Voice, WhatsApp, Email and Website AI agents engage customers autonomously, sharing one contextual memory across channels.
7. **CRM Intelligence** — every interaction automatically updates the customer's CRM record with structured data.

## RevEngg — Platform Features

- Unified lead pipeline across 6+ acquisition channels
- AI-generated ad creative variants with automatic winner promotion
- Automatic lead enrichment (company, revenue, industry, intent, location, social)
- AI lead scoring and priority-queue routing
- Contextual decision engine for next-best-action planning
- Voice, WhatsApp, Email, Website and SMS conversation agents sharing one memory
- Automatic CRM sync: HubSpot, Salesforce, Zoho, Freshsales, Pipedrive

## RevEngg — Key Facts

- **Who it's for:** B2C e-commerce brands and the marketing/growth/CX teams that run them.
- **Category:** Autonomous revenue engineering / AI-driven RevOps platform.
- **Differentiators vs Klaviyo, Gorgias, HubSpot, and traditional marketing automation:** RevEngg runs the full lifecycle autonomously (discovery through retention) rather than automating a single channel; conversation agents share one contextual memory across Voice, WhatsApp, Email and Web; CRM updates are fully automatic and structured.
- **Reported outcomes:** up to 45% more qualified leads, 60% faster lead response, 35% higher customer retention, 3x revenue growth, 90% automation rate, 24×7 always-on engagement.

## Spark — What It Is

Spark is an embeddable AI website assistant by Helllo.ai. It trains on your approved site content and uploaded files, answers visitor questions by chat or voice, navigates to pages mid-conversation, and books meetings on your calendar — with no developer required.

## Spark — How It Works

1. **Paste your URL** — Spark reads your pages and builds an assistant that knows your services, prices, hours, and policies.
2. **Teach it the rest** — Add PDFs, price lists, and Q&A pairs. Retrain in one click when content changes.
3. **Embed with one line** — Drop a script tag in your footer or site builder (WordPress, Wix, Webflow, Shopify).
4. **Watch visits become leads** — Spark answers, guides, books meetings, and captures contacts 24/7.

## Spark — Platform Features

- Trained on your site — answers grounded in approved pages and uploaded files
- Voice + chat in one embeddable widget
- Guided navigation — opens pages mid-conversation
- Meeting booking via Google Calendar, Calendly, and Cal.com
- Lightweight lead CRM with searchable conversations and contacts
- Answer control and guardrails with one-click revisions
- Live monitoring and analytics
- 50+ language auto-detection
- Brand customization for colors, avatar, tone, and welcome screen

## Spark — Key Facts

- **Who it's for:** SMB website owners, marketing teams, and agencies.
- **Setup:** No developer required. One script tag in site footer or Webflow/Framer custom code.
- **Training data:** Approved website pages and uploaded files only — not the open internet.
- **Free plan:** Free forever — 500 credits, 10 pages crawled, ~30 min voice, ~100 chat conversations. No credit card.
- **Paid plans:** Starter $49/mo, Growth $99/mo, Scale $299/mo, Enterprise custom.
- **Differentiators vs Intercom/Drift:** Guided navigation (takes visitors to pages mid-chat), in-browser voice, training from actual site content.

## Spark — Frequently Asked Questions

### Do I need a developer?
No. Copy one script tag into your site footer. Works with Webflow, Framer, WordPress, Shopify, and any HTML site in about 2 minutes.

### Will it hallucinate about my business?
No. Answers are grounded in pages you approve and files you upload. If Spark doesn't know something, it says so.

### Is my data used to train other AI models?
No. Your content trains only your assistant and is never used to train foundation models or shared with other customers.

### Can I try it before signing up?
Yes. Paste your URL and chat with a homepage-trained assistant immediately — no account or credit card required.

### Why do I need to verify my domain?
So only you can train an assistant on your site. Standard ownership check via DNS TXT record or HTML meta tag.

### Chat or voice — which does it support?
Both, in the same widget. Visitors type or tap the mic. Browser-native — no app or phone system required.

### What makes Spark different from Intercom or Drift?
Guided navigation (Spark navigates to pages mid-conversation), in-browser voice, and training from your actual site content. Built for SMB websites.

### Does it work on mobile?
Yes. Fully responsive and touch-optimised — tap to chat, tap to talk, swipe to close.

### What happens when my free credits run out?
The assistant stops responding until you upgrade or add credits. We email you before they run out.

## Helllo Voice — What It Is

Helllo Voice is Helllo.ai's production-ready AI voice agent platform, powered by agentic orchestration, for enterprise customer experience automation over the phone and other voice channels.

## Helllo Voice — Platform Features

- Agentic flows and orchestration
- Production-ready AI voice agents
- Customer experience automation
- CRM integration
- Multi-language support
- Enterprise-grade security
- Real-time analytics

## Helllo Voice — Key Facts

- **Who it's for:** Businesses of all sizes needing voice-based customer experience automation.
- **Setup:** Easy setup with CRM integration and multi-language support.
- **Free trial:** 30 minutes monthly.
